meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行创建、预览和发布动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用简单的命令制作和分享动画视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and publish animated videos with a command-line tool.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create and share animated videos using simple commands.

howto.what: 让 Claude 使用 HyperFrames CLI 开发循环来制作并渲染动效视频，支持本地或 HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda 等环境，也能诊断构建/渲染失败。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行 HyperFrames 动效视频的开发循环（如初始化、检查、渲染等），或诊断构建/渲染失败时。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 初始化一个新项目。
在 HyperFrames 目录里搜索“逐行揭示标题”的动效。
对这个 HyperFrames 项目运行 check 并预览。
say.note: Claude 会先 lint 再 check，然后打开预览。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use the HyperFrames CLI development loop to create and render motion videos locally or on HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, etc.; also diagnose build/render failures.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a HyperFrames motion-video development loop (init, checks, render, etc.) or to diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.note: Claude runs npx hyperframes init to scaffold it.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a 'reveal headline line by line' motion.
say_en.note: Claude runs catalog --query and lists matches.

say_en.text: Run check and preview this HyperFrames project.
say_en.note: Claude runs lint, then check, then opens the preview.
